messages.subject: Styling updateCheckboxGroupInput function's label component
parts:
Is it possible to style updateCheckboxGroupInput function's label component?
If I style it as label = h3( paste("Checkboxgroup label", length(x)) ) then the label is not displayed and instead it displays [object Object], but I want my text/header styles to match each other


## Only run examples in interactive R sessions if(interactive()){ ui <- fluidPage( p("The first checkbox group controls the second"),
column(3, checkboxGroupInput(inputId = "inCheckboxGroup", label = h3("Input checkbox"), c("Item A", "Item B", "Item C"))), column(3, checkboxGroupInput(inputId = "inCheckboxGroup2", label = h3("Input checkbox 2"),
c("Item A", "Item B", "Item C"))) ) server <- function(input, output, session) { observe({ x <- input$inCheckboxGroup # Can use character(0) to remove all choices if (is.null(x)) x <- character(0) # Can also set the label and select items updateCheckboxGroupInput(session, inputId = "inCheckboxGroup2", label = paste("Checkboxgroup label", length(x)), choices = x, selected = x ) }) } shinyApp(ui, server) }
